rows.label: qst640408_msg0003
rows.name:
Our dads were okay, right? The hot
springs just went back to normal,
so...

rows.label: qst640408_msg0004
rows.name:
That's right... Thanks to our efforts,
everything's settled.

rows.label: qst640408_msg0005
rows.name:
Your fathers said they'll be home
soon.

rows.label: qst640408_msg0007
rows.name:
Luckily, it looks like Kasane's power
didn't come into play.

rows.label: qst640408_msg0011
rows.name:
Come on, let's get in the hot spring.
Nothing beats a soak after a job well
done!

rows.label: qst640408_msg0012
rows.name:
Girls, how about joining us in the hot
spring?

rows.label: qst640408_msg0013
rows.name:
Ah, so Rinne really did have an
ulterior motive...

rows.label: qst640408_msg0015
rows.name:
Chatting and tea parties are more fun
with more people, right?

rows.label: qst640408_msg0018
rows.name:
You're going bathing in
the Shamayim Hot Spring?

rows.label: qst640408_msg0020
rows.name:
I won a pass in the raffle for
unlimited daily entry to a hot spring
in Superbia!

rows.label: qst640408_msg0021
rows.name:
Kasane was the one who won it,
though...

rows.label: qst640408_msg0022
rows.name:
Wow... I never knew you could
win something like that!

rows.label: qst640408_msg0024
rows.name: Here... Bow down and worship it.

rows.label: qst640408_msg0025
rows.name:
...Isn't this for a different hot
spring than Shamayim?

rows.label: qst640408_msg0028
rows.name:
Look closely. It says unlimited entry
to the 'Nopon Pioneers' Secret Hot
Spring.'

rows.label: qst640408_msg0030
rows.name:
Was it outside the city, past the Old
Industrial District and then beyond
the Old City of Elgria?

rows.label: qst640408_msg0035
rows.name:
He deliberately kept it vague and only
said 'a hot spring in Superbia.'

rows.label: qst640408_msg0038
rows.name:
It's a secret hot spring, so I'm sure
it'll be a wonderful place.

rows.label: qst640408_msg0040
rows.name:
At this point, we may as well enjoy
it, right?

rows.label: qst640408_msg0042
rows.name:
Let's bring every companion we can and
go to the secret hot spring!
